draft.subject: Edge AI perception on Jetson, Robotics Systems Engineer
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas and I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from the Rochester Institute of Technology. I came across LuminX's Robotics Systems Engineer role and wanted to reach out to you as the technical co-founder.

I deployed quantized vision models on NVIDIA Jetson using TensorRT for fast, real-time execution. I also established a multi camera capture pipeline to capture LeRobot formatted datasets and reliably got a robot picking parts reliably by resolving integration failures, such as servo brownouts and stale camera frames. I have hands on with sensors, wiring, and hardware bring up.

Running perception on edge cameras out in real warehouses is exactly the problem I want to work on. If time permits and my profile seems like a good fit I would appreciate a short conversation about the role and what the company is looking for. Attached is my resume.
draft.hook_used: Domain relevance: technical co-founder building the exact edge-camera perception systems Justin has built
